header.title: Rising streaming subscriptions and pricing lift recorded music revenue through 2035

s01_bottom_line.text: GS Research raised its long-term music industry outlook for the first time in three years, forecasting global music revenues to grow 5.8% annually to nearly $200bn in 2035 from $112bn in 2025, driven by faster-than-expected subscriber growth and rising revenue per user. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩
The article frames rising subscriptions, pricing, physical formats and new tiers as creating opportunities for the industry to grow revenue through 2035. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩

A structurally improving streaming revenue picture is a positive for recorded music rights holders and streaming platforms, but the article names no listed companies and does not quantify the earnings impact on any specific issuer.
